title: Running an AI-native engineering org
description: When agentic coding goes from individual tool to org-wide default, the tool isn't the hard part…your processes are. Fiona Fung, Leader for Engineering and Product for Claude Code and Cowork, walks through how the bottlenecks changed at Anthropic (review, ownership, hiring) and the norms we rewrote to keep shipping.
